notes: even unto the great sea: no עד stands in the clause, so the waw takes only the bare even (rule 16 records no waw aligned to even unto), and the supplied unto belongs to הים as an accusative of extent under rule 33, discontinuous around the great.
בנחלה is read as rule 49's resultative frame to be, headed on to; the indefinite a belongs to נחלה under rule 15.
מבוא takes the supplied toward (rule 33) and a supplied the (rule 29), headed on going; the article on שמש takes the the standing before its own word in the arthrous rendering of the sun.
